summary: Comprehensive testing of Community Messaging feature for Heroic HIFI Foundation. Fixed missing Community link in navbar. All 24 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed for Community page, Directory, Messaging, and Admin Messages tab.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - Community link was missing from navbar for logged-in users
FIXED - messageThreads state was never populated (missing /api/admin/messages call)

passed_tests: Community page (/community) requires login - redirects to /login if not authenticated
After login, 'Community' link appears in the navbar for logged-in users
Community page shows a directory of members (name, role/designation) with 'Connect' buttons
GET /api/directory returns list of users (excluding admin, excluding PAN/Aadhaar/address)
POST /api/messages sends a message successfully
GET /api/messages/thread/{email} returns thread with number-stripped messages for received msgs
GET /api/messages/conversations returns conversation list
Number stripping: digits '123' becomes '[*]', word 'one' stripped but 'done' preserved
Admin Dashboard 'Messages' tab: GET /api/admin/messages lists all conversation threads
Admin can click a thread and see unredacted messages via GET /api/admin/messages/thread/{email1}/{email2}
Admin Dashboard has 6 tabs: Overview, Donations, Volunteers, Queries, Messages, Users
Directory endpoint requires authentication (401 without token)
Directory excludes admin users from listing
Directory excludes sensitive fields (PAN, Aadhaar, address, password_hash)
Cannot send message to non-existent user (404)
Cannot send message to yourself (400)
Conversations endpoint requires authentication
Thread endpoint requires authentication
Admin messages endpoint requires admin role
Admin thread endpoint requires admin role
Full messaging flow between two test users with number stripping verification
seed_data_creation: Test users created during backend tests are automatically cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Community Messaging feature is fully implemented and tested. The strip_numbers function uses word boundaries (\b) for English words to avoid false positives like 'done' matching 'one'. Admin can view all message threads unredacted in the Dashboard Messages tab. Test users can be created via OTP flow (OTP is returned in debug mode when Resend API key is not configured).

mocked_apis.Razorpay: Payment verification mocked - placeholder env keys
mocked_apis.Resend: OTP email delivery mocked - OTP returned in response for testing
